Population increased in Tandridge

The estimated population of Tandridge in 2024 was 90,586 usual residents, a rise of 0.6% since 2023.

This meant that Tandridge's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Tandridge increased by 2.8%.

Over this slightly longer period, Tandridge was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Tandridge

The average (median) age rose to 44 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Tandridge has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Tandridge is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Tandridge's population of 90,586 usual residents was made up of:

  • 17,155 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.9%)
  • 54,055 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.7%)
  • 19,376 people aged 65 years and over, (21.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Tandridge has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (59.7% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Tandridge, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Tandridge
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Tandridge, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 79 people (-0.1%). In total, there were 818 births and 897 deaths in Tandridge.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 256 (0.3%). There were 6,453 people entering the area and 6,197 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Tandridge's population of 368 (0.4%) as a result of 605 people entering the area and 237 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Tandridge was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Tandridge in mid-2023 is 90,049.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 246 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 394 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 640 people.
